# Notable

Notable is a digital platform for audience members to send feedback, suggestions, and tips directly to Riza Fahmi.

## Public Pages
- [Kirim Feedback & Tips](https://feedback.rizafahmi.com/) - The main landing page for viewers and donors to submit free feedback and optional tips via dynamic QRIS.
- [OBS Overlay](https://feedback.rizafahmi.com/overlay) - An unauthenticated, transparent widget for presentation overlays (OBS/Streamlabs) to render floating emoji reactions and sequential tip alert cards.
- [Tanya Jawab](https://feedback.rizafahmi.com/questions) - Public audience Q&A board for submitting questions and upvoting what Riza should answer next.

{:error, :rate_limited} ->
        {:noreply,
         socket
         |> put_flash(:error, "Tunggu sebentar ya, coba lagi dalam beberapa detik.")
         |> assign_form(changeset)}

      {:error, _changeset} ->
        _ = SubmissionLimiter.release(key)

        {:noreply,
         socket
         |> put_flash(:error, "Pertanyaan belum bisa dikirim. Coba lagi.")
         |> assign_form(changeset)}
    end
  end

{:error, :rate_limited} ->
        {:noreply,
         socket
         |> put_flash(:error, "Tunggu sebentar ya, coba lagi dalam beberapa detik.")
         |> assign(:form_expanded, true)
         |> assign_form(changeset)}

      {:error, _changeset} ->
        _ = SubmissionLimiter.release(key)

        {:noreply,
         socket
         |> put_flash(:error, "Pertanyaan belum bisa dikirim. Coba lagi.")
         |> assign(:form_expanded, true)
         |> assign_form(changeset)}
